title: ComplexMCP: Evaluation of LLM Agents in Dynamic, Interdependent, and Large-Scale Tool Sandbox
authors_zh: Yuanyang Li, Xue Yang, Longyue Wang, Weihua Luo, Hongyang Chen
paper_type_zh: 可执行 MCP 智能体基准与成功参考轨迹发布
best_for_zh: 研究环境智能体轨迹、状态差分 verifier、工具检索与可复现评测审计的读者
one_line: ComplexMCP pairs 47 manually curated tasks with seeded 315-tool environments, accepted gold tool trajectories, and final-state verification, while leaving full model rollouts and a paper-era release freeze unavailable.
ComplexMCP 将 47 个手工任务、15 个 MCP server 的 315 个工具、成功参考轨迹与状态差分 verifier 组合为可执行评测对象，但未发布完整模型 rollout、论文时期版本锁与独立 rights 声明。
why: It makes long-horizon agent reasoning inspectable at the state-action level—queries, tool calls, observations, target state, collateral changes, and success—but also shows why executable benchmarks need immutable releases, verifier tests, security calibration, and complete rollout retention before reuse as post-training data.
inclusion_reason: ComplexMCP exposes a rare auditable environment-agent data object: seeded mutable state, interdependent tools, accepted action/observation traces, final-state targets, and explicit completion-versus-collateral-change checks. It is directly relevant to reasoning-data evaluation while illustrating version, verifier, security, and rollout-retention risks.

title: Problem
问题
html:
ComplexMCP is an ICML 2026 benchmark for evaluating language-model agents in a dynamic MCP sandbox. The primary paper is the ICML/OpenReview version, cross-checked against arXiv:2605.10787v2 and the official ATH-MaaS/complex-mcp repository. Artifact-level statements in this Card use current-main commit 617e963bd838bee5793a39e6b34165b79535828f, inspected on 2026-07-20, because no tag or release connects that snapshot to the paper experiments.

The paper targets a gap between short, independent tool-use benchmarks and realistic workflows whose actions change shared state, depend on earlier actions, and can trigger transient failures. A task comprises a natural-language instruction, deterministic seed, available tools, initial application state, goal state, and evaluator. The agent must discover relevant tools, inspect state, execute interdependent actions, handle observations or failures, and finish without unrelated state changes. This is an evaluation problem, not a reported agent-training recipe.

The benchmark contains 47 manually curated tasks over 15 MCP servers and 315 tools: seven stateful application servers and eight stateless service servers. The stateful applications are LightOS/System, LightTalk, LightShop, LightWeather, LightFlight, LightStock, and LightNews. Queries omit explicit tool-name hints, while seeded initialization and perturbations make the environment itself part of the feedback contract.

The released data object is a 47-row, seven-column data.parquet table. Its fields are seed, query, apps, level, output, tool_cnt, and gt_env. Each output is one accepted human-authored successful reference demonstration containing reasoning/text, JSON tool calls, tool responses, and an [END] marker; gt_env is the nested target final state. The release therefore contains 47 successful gold/reference trajectories, not the complete successful and failed model rollouts from every model and trial reported in the paper.

This object belongs in environment_agent_trajectory_data because task state, action, observation, mutable transition, final state, completion, collateral change, and terminal outcome can be examined together. Its present evidence supports an L4-depth Card draft, while the accepted metadata correctly remains L3_summary_ready and partial: paper-era version identity, full replay artifacts, independent rights, and verifier/security calibration are unresolved.

ComplexMCP 是一个面向动态 MCP sandbox 中语言模型智能体的 ICML 2026 评测基准。主要论文来源为 ICML/OpenReview 版本，并与 arXiv:2605.10787v2 及官方 ATH-MaaS/complex-mcp 仓库交叉核验。由于仓库没有把某个 tag 或 release 对应到论文实验，本卡的 artifact 级陈述固定到 2026 年 7 月 20 日检查的 current-main commit 617e963bd838bee5793a39e6b34165b79535828f。

论文关注短程、彼此独立的 tool-use benchmark 与真实工作流之间的差距：真实动作会改变共享状态，后续操作依赖先前动作，还可能遇到瞬时故障。一个任务由自然语言指令、确定性 seed、可用工具、应用初始状态、目标状态和 evaluator 构成。智能体需要发现相关工具、检查状态、执行相互依赖的动作、处理 observation 或故障，并在不引入无关状态改动的情况下结束。这是 evaluation 问题，不是论文报告的智能体训练 recipe。

基准包含 47 个手工整理任务，覆盖 15 个 MCP server 和 315 个工具，其中有 7 个 stateful application server 与 8 个 stateless service server。7 个有状态应用是 LightOS/System、LightTalk、LightShop、LightWeather、LightFlight、LightStock 和 LightNews。query 不提供显式工具名提示；带 seed 的初始化与扰动使环境本身成为反馈契约的一部分。

发布的数据对象是一个 47 行、7 列的 data.parquet 表，字段为 seed、query、apps、level、output、tool_cnt 和 gt_env。每个 output 是一条通过人工验收的成功参考 demonstration，包含 reasoning/text、JSON tool call、tool response 和 [END] 标记；gt_env 保存嵌套的目标最终状态。因此，release 提供的是 47 条成功 gold/reference trajectory，而不是论文对每个模型、每次 trial 评测所得的全部成功与失败 rollout。

该对象属于 environment_agent_trajectory_data，因为 task state、action、observation、可变状态转移、final state、completion、collateral change 与 terminal outcome 可以被联合审计。现有证据足以支撑 L4 深度的 Card 草稿，但 accepted metadata 仍正确保持 L3_summary_ready 与 partial：论文时期版本身份、完整 replay artifact、独立 rights 以及 verifier/security calibration 仍未解决。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
ComplexMCP's central contribution is to make long-horizon MCP interaction evaluable through both required final-state changes and unintended collateral changes. The sandbox exposes many tools over interdependent applications; a deterministic seed establishes initial state and perturbations, and a recursive state-difference evaluator compares the resulting environment with the task target.

The data/evaluation object has two layers. The task layer binds a query and application set to a seed, difficulty level, accepted reference trajectory, reference call count, and target state. The episode layer is an ordered ReAct-style history of model or annotator text, named tool calls with JSON arguments, structured responses or errors, implicit state transitions, an end condition, and a captured final state. The current release materializes one accepted human reference episode for each of 47 tasks; evaluated model histories are reported chiefly through aggregate metrics rather than released as a complete corpus.

The feedback contract is explicit. Let the target-state diff contain T required changes. Completion is M/T, where M is the number of matched required changes. Misbehavior is Mb/T, where Mb counts collateral changes. Binary success requires completion 1 and misbehavior 0. The evaluator recursively compares nested state, excludes selected timestamp or random-ID fields, and applies special fuzzy matching to content fields. This contract observes encoded final-state requirements and unintended diffs; it cannot establish whether an unencoded semantic requirement was satisfied, whether a valid alternative state should count, or whether a reasoning trace is intrinsically high quality.

The closest comparison in the assigned track is tau2-bench: both treat an executable stateful environment as part of the verifier, but tau2-bench centers dual-control customer-service interaction and releases evaluated success/failure episodes under a paper-era tag. ComplexMCP instead centers large MCP tool spaces, cross-application dependencies, seeded faults, and final-state collateral-change accounting, while its current official release retains only accepted gold/reference episodes and lacks a paper-era release lock.

The direction signal is therefore not “more tools” alone. It is the coupling of stateful tasks, action/observation histories, target-state deltas, and collateral-change checks as one auditable evaluation object. That signal remains bounded by the public evaluator implementation, incomplete rollout retention, and uncalibrated security exposure.

ComplexMCP 的核心贡献，是同时依据必需的最终状态变化与非预期 collateral change 来评测长程 MCP 交互。sandbox 在多个相互依赖的应用上暴露大量工具；确定性 seed 规定初始状态和扰动，递归状态差分 evaluator 再把执行后的环境与任务目标比较。

数据／评测对象有两层。task 层把 query 与 application set 绑定到 seed、difficulty level、通过验收的参考轨迹、参考调用数和目标状态。episode 层则是有序的 ReAct-style history，包含模型或标注者文本、带 JSON 参数的具名 tool call、结构化 response 或 error、隐式状态转移、结束条件和捕获的 final state。current release 为 47 个任务各物化一条人工接受的参考 episode；被评测模型的 history 主要以汇总指标报告，并未作为完整 corpus 发布。

反馈契约是明确的。设 target-state diff 中有 T 个必需变化，completion 为 M/T，其中 M 是匹配的必需变化数；misbehavior 为 Mb/T，其中 Mb 统计 collateral change；binary success 要求 completion 等于 1 且 misbehavior 等于 0。evaluator 递归比较嵌套状态，排除部分 timestamp 或 random-ID 字段，并对 content 字段使用特殊 fuzzy matching。该契约能观察编码进目标状态的要求与非预期差分，但不能证明未编码的语义要求已满足、有效替代状态应被接受，或 reasoning trace 本身质量较高。

在指定 track 中，最近的对照是 tau2-bench：二者都把可执行有状态环境作为 verifier 的组成部分；但 tau2-bench 关注双控制客服交互，并在论文时期 tag 下发布成功与失败评测 episode。ComplexMCP 更关注大规模 MCP tool space、跨应用依赖、seeded fault 与最终状态 collateral-change accounting；其当前官方 release 只保留通过验收的 gold/reference episode，且没有论文时期 release lock。

因此，方向信号并不只是“工具更多”，而是把 stateful task、action/observation history、target-state delta 与 collateral-change check 连接为同一个可审计 evaluation object。其有效边界仍受公开 evaluator 实现、rollout 保留不完整以及未经校准的安全暴露限制。

title: Method
方法
html:
Inputs and environment. An undisclosed LLM is used to pre-populate synthetic application entities intended to resemble real-world distributions. Human curators then define cross-application natural-language tasks with deterministic unique outcomes and without explicit tool-name hints. A task selects applications and a seed; the seed controls initial state and execution perturbations, including transient network errors. The configured substrate has 15 MCP servers and 315 tools, split into seven stateful and eight stateless servers.

Reference construction and acceptance. Human experts interact through the MCP interface to write a ground-truth trajectory for each task. The inspected construction script serializes text, tool-call JSON, responses, and the end marker, then stores the row only after the annotator answers yes to Pass this query?. The full rubric, annotator identities and count, agreement procedure, rejected attempts, and rejection counts are unknown. The resulting parquet contains 47 accepted rows and seven fields: seed, query, apps, level, output, tool_cnt, and gt_env; all cells were non-null in the inspected snapshot.

Model rollout. The main evaluation uses ReAct. Full-context prompting supplies all tool descriptions, reported as about 29,964 tokens; fixed top-k retrieval and iterative retrieval variants use all-MiniLM-L6-v2. Each evaluated model runs independently three times on all 47 tasks. The client opens a new UUID session from the supplied seed, injects the session into stateful calls, and deletes it at logout. This is a seeded process-local reset rather than a released persisted snapshot.

Stopping and observations. Ordered model text, tool calls, and response blocks are accumulated. The agent can emit [END]; the current runner also stops after 100 turns or five consecutive non-tool responses. Tools can return structured successes or simulated failures. Exact provider revision, temperature, top-p, wall-clock budget, model-sampling seed, dependency lock, and fault-schedule export are not supplied by the current runner.

Verifier and output. The evaluator recursively computes the required target-state diff and extra collateral changes. Completion is matched required changes divided by required changes; misbehavior is collateral changes divided by required changes; success requires complete target satisfaction and zero collateral change. Content fields allow exact, substring, or Levenshtein-similarity-above-0.7 matches. The runner prints aggregate metrics but does not persist the complete evaluated rollout, trial identifier, model-sampling seed, environment hash, or result manifest.

Use and reconstruction boundary. The paper uses this pipeline only for evaluation. A defensible replay must pin the exact code/data/evaluator commit, dependencies, server configuration, model and provider revision, decoding settings, seed and fault schedule, task row, session behavior, and metric implementation. The official repository's current commit is inspectable, but no tag or release identifies it as the paper-era experiment snapshot.

输入与环境。 一个身份未披露的 LLM 被用于预生成接近真实分布的合成应用实体。人工 curator 随后定义跨应用自然语言任务，要求结果确定且唯一，并且不在 query 中提供显式工具名提示。每个任务选择 application 和 seed；seed 控制初始状态与执行扰动，包括瞬时 network error。配置的 substrate 含 15 个 MCP server 和 315 个工具，其中 7 个 server 有状态、8 个无状态。

参考轨迹构造与验收。 人类专家通过 MCP interface 为每个任务编写 ground-truth trajectory。已检查的构造脚本会序列化文本、tool-call JSON、response 和结束标记，并且只有标注者对 Pass this query? 回答 yes 后才保存记录。完整 rubric、标注者身份与人数、agreement procedure、被拒尝试及拒绝数量均为 unknown。最终 parquet 含 47 条已接受记录和 7 个字段：seed、query、apps、level、output、tool_cnt 与 gt_env；检查的 snapshot 中所有单元格均非空。

模型 rollout。 主评测使用 ReAct。full-context prompting 提供全部工具描述，论文报告约占 29,964 tokens；fixed top-k retrieval 与 iterative retrieval variant 使用 all-MiniLM-L6-v2。每个被评测模型在全部 47 个任务上独立运行 3 次。client 根据给定 seed 打开新的 UUID session，把 session 注入 stateful call，并在 logout 时删除。这是带 seed 的进程内 reset，不是发布的持久化 snapshot。

停止条件与 observation。 系统按序累积模型文本、tool call 与 response block。agent 可以发出 [END]；current runner 还会在 100 turns 后或连续 5 次没有 tool call 的 response 后停止。工具可能返回结构化成功结果或 simulated failure。current runner 未提供精确 provider revision、temperature、top-p、wall-clock budget、model-sampling seed、dependency lock 或 fault-schedule export。

Verifier 与输出。 evaluator 递归计算必需的 target-state diff 和额外 collateral change。completion 等于匹配必需变化数除以必需变化总数；misbehavior 等于 collateral change 数除以必需变化总数；success 要求目标完全满足且 collateral change 为零。content 字段允许 exact match、substring match 或 Levenshtein similarity 高于 0.7 的匹配。runner 会打印汇总指标，但不持久化完整 evaluated rollout、trial identifier、model-sampling seed、environment hash 或 result manifest。

用途与重建边界。 论文只把这套 pipeline 用于 evaluation。可靠 replay 必须固定精确的 code/data/evaluator commit、dependency、server configuration、model/provider revision、decoding setting、seed 与 fault schedule、task row、session behavior 以及 metric implementation。官方仓库 current commit 可检查，但没有 tag 或 release 证明它就是论文时期的实验 snapshot。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
Under the paper's main ReAct evaluation, every model is run independently three times on all 47 tasks. The best reported row in Table 2 is Gemini-3-Flash: 55.31 ± 0.00% success, 85.79 ± 0.50% completion, and 4.39 ± 0.19% misbehavior. The reported human success rate is 93.61 ± 1.74%. These numbers show a gap on the benchmark's own state-difference contract; they do not prove that the released reference trajectories are suitable training data or that the evaluator captures every semantic requirement.

The paper reports about 29,964 tokens for the full-context tool descriptions and an average of 11 tool rounds. In Table 3, retrieval-based variants underperform full-context prompting; iterative RAG reaches 36.88 ± 2.01% success for Gemini-3-Flash. The authors associate errors with retrieval saturation, clean-slate assumptions or omitted state checks, and premature defeat after transient errors. These are benchmark-conditioned observations, not evidence that one retrieval design universally dominates.

The strongest artifact evidence is structural. Direct inspection of pinned data.parquet finds exactly 47 rows and seven columns, no null cells, one accepted reference output per task, and a nested target gt_env. The official config enumerates 15 MCP servers and 315 tools, and the runner, client, construction script, and evaluator expose episode execution and scoring logic. Appendix C provides three successful and two failed qualitative model trajectories.

The release boundary is equally important. The 47 parquet rows are successful ground-truth/reference demonstrations accepted during task authoring. They are not the paper's complete model-by-task-by-trial rollout set. The repository tree does not supply all successful and failed evaluated histories, and Appendix C's five examples do not close that gap. Aggregate scores therefore cannot be reverse-engineered into a complete trajectory corpus.

The current artifact also exposes a version discrepancy: the paper says the hardest task requires more than 60 tool invocations, while the inspected parquet's reference call counts do not exceed 59. This may reflect a paper-era/current-main difference or a counting-definition difference; without a paper-linked release, it should remain unresolved rather than being treated as a paper error.

在论文的主要 ReAct 评测中，每个模型都在全部 47 个任务上独立运行 3 次。Table 2 报告的最佳一行是 Gemini-3-Flash：success 为 55.31 ± 0.00%，completion 为 85.79 ± 0.50%，misbehavior 为 4.39 ± 0.19%；human success 为 93.61 ± 1.74%。这些数字显示的是模型在该 benchmark 自身状态差分契约下的差距，不能证明发布的参考轨迹适合作为训练数据，也不能证明 evaluator 捕获了全部语义要求。

论文报告 full-context 工具描述约占 29,964 tokens，平均有 11 个 tool round。Table 3 中，retrieval-based variant 低于 full-context prompting；Gemini-3-Flash 的 iterative RAG success 为 36.88 ± 2.01%。作者把错误与 retrieval saturation、clean-slate assumption 或遗漏 state check、以及遇到瞬时错误后过早放弃联系起来。这些是受 benchmark 条件约束的 observation，不是某种 retrieval 设计普遍占优的证据。

最强的 artifact 证据来自结构。直接检查固定版本的 data.parquet 可见恰好 47 行、7 列，没有 null cell；每个任务有一条已接受的参考 output 和一个嵌套目标 gt_env。官方 config 枚举 15 个 MCP server 与 315 个工具，runner、client、construction script 和 evaluator 则暴露 episode 执行及评分逻辑。Appendix C 只给出 3 条成功和 2 条失败的模型定性轨迹。

release 边界同样重要。parquet 的 47 行是任务编写阶段接受的成功 ground-truth/reference demonstration，不是论文中完整的 model-by-task-by-trial rollout 集合。仓库树没有提供所有成功与失败的被评测 history，Appendix C 的 5 个例子也不能填补这一缺口。因此，不能从汇总 score 反推出完整 trajectory corpus。

current artifact 还暴露一处版本差异：论文称最难任务需要超过 60 次工具调用，而已检查 parquet 的参考调用计数不超过 59。这可能来自 paper-era 与 current-main 的差异，也可能来自计数定义差异；在没有论文关联 release 的情况下，应保留为 unresolved，而不能直接判定为论文错误。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
Prior tool-use benchmarks often reduce success to an answer string, a single API call, or a short isolated workflow. Environment-agent benchmarks add state and multi-turn execution, but they differ in whether they expose the action/observation trace, target state, collateral changes, failures, and replay metadata. Against that baseline, ComplexMCP combines a large MCP interface with cross-application dependencies, seeded perturbations, manually accepted reference trajectories, and a final-state verifier that separately reports task completion and unintended change.

The concrete change is the evaluation object and feedback interface. A 47-task record couples the natural-language instruction and application set to a seed, a successful human reference trace, a target nested environment state, and state-difference metrics. Because the verifier penalizes collateral modifications rather than checking only the requested target, it makes side effects visible as a first-class evaluation dimension.

Several components are not new in isolation: ReAct, embedding-based tool retrieval, synthetic application state, programmatic final-state checks, and human-written demonstrations all predate this paper. The benchmark's direction signal lies in integrating them around MCP-scale interdependent state and making the evaluator implementation inspectable. Its 315-tool scale is an engineering expansion, not by itself evidence of better trajectory data.

The release also provides a useful negative lesson for reasoning-data curation. Publishing one successful reference episode per task makes task semantics and tool paths inspectable, but omitting all evaluated success/failure rollouts prevents audit of model behavior across the three trials. Public target states and evaluator code improve transparency while also enabling contamination and benchmark-specific optimization.

Before reuse, a researcher should verify a paper-era immutable release, complete rollout retention, task and provider manifests, rights for task rows and generated outputs, replay behavior under injected faults, and independent tests of fuzzy comparison, exclusion keys, collateral-change accounting, and prompt-injection exposure. Benchmark performance is not a substitute for those quality checks.

既有 tool-use benchmark 往往把成功简化为答案字符串、单次 API call 或短程独立 workflow。environment-agent benchmark 会加入状态与多轮执行，但对于 action/observation trace、target state、collateral change、failure 和 replay metadata 的暴露程度并不相同。相较于这一 baseline，ComplexMCP 把大规模 MCP interface、跨应用依赖、seeded perturbation、人工接受的参考轨迹，以及分别报告任务完成度和非预期变化的 final-state verifier 组合起来。

具体改变在于 evaluation object 与 feedback interface。一条 47-task release 中的记录把自然语言指令和 application set 绑定到 seed、成功人工参考 trace、嵌套目标环境状态及状态差分 metric。由于 verifier 不只检查请求目标，还惩罚 collateral modification，side effect 因而成为一等评测维度。

若单独看，各组件并非全新：ReAct、embedding-based tool retrieval、合成应用状态、程序化 final-state check 与人工 demonstration 都早于本工作。该 benchmark 的方向信号来自围绕 MCP-scale interdependent state 进行整合，并让 evaluator implementation 可检查。315-tool 的规模属于工程扩展，本身不能证明 trajectory data 更优。

release 还为 reasoning-data curation 提供了一个有用的负面经验。每个任务发布一条成功参考 episode，使 task semantics 与 tool path 可检查；但不发布全部成功／失败 evaluated rollout，就无法审计模型在 3 次 trial 中的行为。公开 target state 和 evaluator code 提高透明度的同时，也会增加 contamination 与 benchmark-specific optimization 风险。

复用前应核验 paper-era immutable release、完整 rollout retention、task/provider manifest、task row 与 generated output 的 rights、注入故障下的 replay behavior，以及对 fuzzy comparison、exclusion key、collateral-change accounting 和 prompt-injection exposure 的独立测试。benchmark performance 不能替代这些质量检查。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
• The official repository has no paper-linked tag or release. All code/data audit claims here concern current-main commit 617e963bd838bee5793a39e6b34165b79535828f, not a proven ICML experiment snapshot. The paper's “more than 60” hardest-task invocation statement and the current table's maximum reference count below that threshold remain an unresolved version or counting discrepancy.
  • Exact replay is not available. The runner does not persist complete evaluated rollouts, trial IDs, model-sampling seeds, environment hashes, result manifests, or exported fault schedules; provider revision and default temperature/top-p are also unknown. A seeded process-local session does not freeze external model behavior or all transient failures.
  • The release contains 47 accepted successful reference trajectories only. It does not contain the complete successful and failed rollouts for every evaluated model and each of three runs. Failed authoring attempts, rejection counts, and a detailed acceptance rubric beyond the visible yes/no prompt are also missing.
  • The current evaluator's content branch accepts exact matches, substring matches, or Levenshtein similarity over 0.7. This may accept a semantically wrong near-match or reject an acceptable reformulation, but no independent calibration set or measured false-positive/false-negative rate is released. This is an implementation risk, not an observed error-rate claim.
  • In the inspected current evaluator, the exclusion-key literal appears to omit a comma between rid and oid, which would concatenate the two strings and may leave those generated IDs unexcluded. This is a code-review finding and potential collateral-change accounting risk; the available evidence does not quantify how often it affects benchmark outcomes.
  • Seeded network failures can return status internel error, while current runner aggregation recognizes only ok, error, and failed. Such events may be omitted from failure-status counts. This is an implementation-level accounting risk, not evidence of a measured benchmark error rate or necessarily of an incorrect final-state score.
  • Synthetic LightTalk histories can sample an attacks corpus containing prompt-injection instructions with 10% probability per contact, yet the paper reports no dedicated prompt-injection metric or robustness calibration. The final-state verifier may not reveal whether an agent followed malicious text when the resulting state still satisfies encoded checks.
  • The synthetic knowledge-base generator model, prompts, upstream source provenance, annotator identities/count, agreement process, recruitment, compensation, and consent are undisclosed. No train/dev/test split or systematic model-pretraining overlap/decontamination audit is supplied; public tasks, targets, traces, and evaluator code create future exposure risk.
  • The repository root is MIT and the arXiv paper is CC BY 4.0, but no separate statement establishes rights for benchmark rows, synthetic entities, or model-generated text/tool outputs. The absence of that rights chain blocks treating the trajectories as generally reusable training data.
  • The paper evaluates agents only. It does not establish SFT, preference optimization, process-supervision, reward-model, or agent-RL use, and its benchmark scores do not prove trajectory quality or generalization beyond the 47 synthetic tasks.

• 官方仓库没有与论文绑定的 tag 或 release。本卡所有 code/data 审计结论都针对 current-main commit 617e963bd838bee5793a39e6b34165b79535828f，不能视为已经证明的 ICML 实验 snapshot。论文关于最难任务“超过 60 次”调用的陈述与当前表中低于该阈值的最大参考计数，仍是未解决的版本或计数口径差异。
  • 精确 replay 不可用。runner 不持久化完整 evaluated rollout、trial ID、model-sampling seed、environment hash、result manifest 或导出的 fault schedule；provider revision 与默认 temperature/top-p 也未知。带 seed 的进程内 session 不能固定外部模型行为或全部瞬时故障。
  • release 只包含 47 条通过验收的成功参考轨迹，不包含每个被评测模型在 3 次运行中的完整成功与失败 rollout。失败的 authoring attempt、拒绝数量，以及可见 yes/no prompt 之外的详细 acceptance rubric 也没有发布。
  • current evaluator 的 content 分支接受 exact match、substring match，或 Levenshtein similarity 高于 0.7 的匹配。这可能接受语义错误的近似项，也可能拒绝可接受的改写，但 release 没有独立 calibration set 或实测 false-positive/false-negative rate。这是实现风险，不是已经观测到的错误率主张。
  • 在已检查的 current evaluator 中，exclusion-key literal 疑似在 rid 与 oid 之间缺少逗号，从而把两个字符串拼接，并可能没有按预期排除这些 generated ID。这是代码审计发现与潜在 collateral-change accounting 风险；现有证据没有量化其影响 benchmark outcome 的频率。
  • seeded network failure 可能返回状态 internel error，而 current runner aggregation 只识别 ok、error 和 failed，因此这类事件可能未计入 failure-status count。这是 implementation-level accounting 风险，不是实测 benchmark error rate 的证据，也不必然意味着 final-state score 错误。
  • 合成 LightTalk history 可按每个 contact 10% 的概率采样包含 prompt-injection instruction 的 attacks corpus，但论文没有报告专门的 prompt-injection metric 或 robustness calibration。若产生的状态仍满足已编码检查，final-state verifier 可能无法反映 agent 是否服从了恶意文本。
  • synthetic knowledge-base generator model、prompt、upstream source provenance、标注者身份与人数、agreement process、recruitment、compensation 和 consent 均未披露。release 没有 train/dev/test split，也没有系统的 model-pretraining overlap/decontamination audit；公开 task、target、trace 与 evaluator code 会带来未来暴露风险。
  • 仓库根目录采用 MIT，arXiv 论文采用 CC BY 4.0，但没有独立声明确认 benchmark row、synthetic entity 或 model-generated text/tool output 的 rights。权利链缺失使这些 trajectory 不能被视为可普遍复用的训练数据。
  • 论文只评测 agent，没有建立 SFT、preference optimization、process supervision、reward-model 或 agent-RL 用途；benchmark score 也不能证明 trajectory quality 或对 47 个合成任务之外场景的泛化。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
For environment_agent_trajectory_data, ComplexMCP is most useful as a version-explicit evaluation and audit substrate. A researcher can connect a task query and seeded initial state to tool selection, JSON arguments, responses or transient errors, mutable state transitions, final target diff, collateral changes, completion, misbehavior, and binary success. This supports failure attribution across tool retrieval, state inspection, planning, execution, recovery, and evaluator mismatch.

The construction pipeline is a concrete benchmark recipe: populate a synthetic application graph, write deterministic cross-application tasks without tool hints, author an executable reference path, gate it through human acceptance, and store both the reference interaction and target state. A stronger implementation should retain rejected candidates, explicit rubric decisions, annotator metadata, per-record provenance, immutable task/evaluator manifests, and complete model runs.

The feedback contract is useful for verifier research. Researchers can perturb required and unrelated state, build semantic-equivalence cases for fuzzy content matching, test every excluded-key path, inject each tool status, and compare automated judgments against blinded human labels. Prompt-injection-bearing LightTalk histories can form a security slice. These uses should report false-positive and false-negative rates rather than assuming that deterministic code is correct.

The released 47 gold/reference trajectories can support schema inspection, task understanding, evaluator unit tests, and paper-linked reproduction attempts. They should not be presented as a complete success/failure corpus, preference pairs, process-supervision labels, or general SFT/RL data. Independent data/model-output rights, split/decontamination controls, full rollouts, and replay manifests are absent.

Safe reuse level is evaluation and audit only, matching the accepted training_use. Pin commit 617e963bd838bee5793a39e6b34165b79535828f when using the inspected release, and state that it is a current-main audit freeze rather than a paper-era lock. Benchmark scores compare configurations under the paper's contract; they do not certify data quality.

对于 environment_agent_trajectory_data，ComplexMCP 最适合作为明确版本的 evaluation 与 audit substrate。研究者可把 task query 和带 seed 的 initial state 连接到 tool selection、JSON argument、response 或 transient error、mutable state transition、final target diff、collateral change、completion、misbehavior 与 binary success，从而在 tool retrieval、state inspection、planning、execution、recovery 和 evaluator mismatch 之间定位失败来源。

其构造 pipeline 是一套具体 benchmark recipe：填充合成 application graph，编写不含工具提示且结果确定的跨应用任务，制作可执行参考路径，通过人工验收 gate，并同时保存 reference interaction 与 target state。更完善的实现还应保留 rejected candidate、显式 rubric decision、annotator metadata、逐条 provenance、不可变 task/evaluator manifest 与完整 model run。

该反馈契约适合 verifier 研究。研究者可以扰动必需状态和无关状态，为 fuzzy content matching 构造 semantic-equivalence case，测试每条 excluded-key path，注入每种 tool status，并把自动判定与盲评 human label 对照。含 prompt injection 的 LightTalk history 可组成 security slice。这些用途应报告 false-positive 与 false-negative rate，而不能假设确定性代码必然正确。

发布的 47 条 gold/reference trajectory 可用于 schema inspection、task understanding、evaluator unit test 和论文关联复现尝试。它们不能被描述为完整 success/failure corpus、preference pair、process-supervision label 或通用 SFT/RL data。独立 data/model-output rights、split/decontamination control、完整 rollout 与 replay manifest 均缺失。

安全复用等级是仅限 evaluation 与 audit，与 accepted training_use 一致。使用已检查 release 时应固定 commit 617e963bd838bee5793a39e6b34165b79535828f，并说明它是 current-main audit freeze，而不是 paper-era lock。benchmark score 只用于在论文契约下比较配置，不能认证 data quality。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
• Keep the scale and object together: 47 tasks, 15 MCP servers, 315 tools, and one seven-field parquet row per task linking seed/query/applications to an accepted reference trajectory and target final state.
  • Separate the two trajectory populations. The release has 47 successful human gold/reference demonstrations; it does not release all model successes and failures from three independent runs, while Appendix C shows only three correct and two incorrect examples.
  • Read the verifier as code, not as an oracle: completion and collateral-change accounting are concrete, but fuzzy content matching, the apparent rid/oid comma omission, and unrecognized internel error status need calibrated tests.
  • Interpret Table 2 within its contract: Gemini-3-Flash reports 55.31 ± 0.00% success versus 93.61 ± 1.74% for humans, but benchmark performance is not evidence of training-data quality.
  • Reuse only for version-pinned evaluation and audit; paper-era code identity, complete replay manifests, separate data/output rights, decontamination, and prompt-injection calibration remain unknown.

• 应把规模与数据对象一起记住：47 个任务、15 个 MCP server、315 个工具；每个任务对应一条 7 字段 parquet 记录，把 seed/query/application 连接到通过验收的参考轨迹和目标最终状态。
  • 必须区分两类 trajectory。release 有 47 条成功人工 gold/reference demonstration，但没有发布 3 次独立运行中的全部模型成功与失败记录；Appendix C 只展示 3 个正确和 2 个错误例子。
  • 应把 verifier 当作代码而不是 oracle：completion 与 collateral-change accounting 很具体，但 fuzzy content matching、疑似 rid/oid 逗号遗漏，以及未被识别的 internel error 状态都需要校准测试。
  • Table 2 必须在其契约内解释：Gemini-3-Flash success 为 55.31 ± 0.00%，human 为 93.61 ± 1.74%，但 benchmark performance 不是 training-data quality 的证据。
  • 仅用于固定版本的 evaluation 与 audit；paper-era code identity、完整 replay manifest、独立 data/output rights、decontamination 与 prompt-injection calibration 仍为 unknown。

label: Verifier / judge failure modes
验证器与评审失效模式

items: Fuzzy substring/Levenshtein matching for content can misclassify semantic equivalence or near-matches.
The current exclusion-key list appears to concatenate rid and oid because of a missing comma, potentially counting generated identifiers as collateral changes.
Seeded network failures return status internel error, while the aggregate runner counts only ok, error, and failed, potentially omitting these calls from status summaries.
State-diff checks can miss requirements not encoded in target state or trajectory rules and are not accompanied by a released adversarial calibration suite.
Synthetic chat histories can contain prompt-injection attacks, but the paper reports no dedicated security robustness metric.
Public task targets, reference trajectories, and evaluator code permit contamination or benchmark-specific optimization.
内容的模糊子串/Levenshtein 匹配可能误分类语义等价或近似匹配。
当前排除键列表似乎因缺少逗号而拼接了 rid 与 oid，可能将生成的标识符计为附带变更。
带 seed 的网络失败返回状态 internel error，而聚合 runner 仅计数 ok、error 与 failed，可能从状态摘要中省略这些调用。
状态差检查可能遗漏未编码在目标状态或轨迹规则中的要求，且无已发布的对抗校准套件相伴。
合成聊天历史可含提示注入攻击，但论文未报告专门的安全鲁棒性指标。
公开任务目标、参考轨迹与评测器代码允许污染或基准特定优化。
